_info: Stufe 1.5b - Zufallsvariation der Greifszene, gelesen von g1sim/randomization.py.
enabled schaltet eine Gruppe an oder aus. Einzelne Zahl = +- Halbbreite um den Normalwert, Liste = [min, max].
Laengen in m, Winkel in Grad, Farben RGB 0..1, Rauschen RGB in Graustufen 0..255.
distractors: only scenes with a distractor pool (volleyball) - count [min, max] of them on the table, keepout_m = gap to ball and basket.
scenes: per scene, narrower ranges laid over the groups above (any key of a group except enabled). volleyball: ball + stand offset
+-0.10 m - the two-hand teacher reaches 20/20 up to ~11 cm, beyond that the far-left starts fail (2026-10-08, 67 --vary objects).
walk: walk world (volleyball_walk, Level 1 Stage 3) - ball and basket shift +-m from their nominal spots, ball-basket separation
[min, max] m, layout rules, waist limit, arrival error added to the stop pose (back [min, max] m, side +-m, yaw +-deg), FK clearance
limits (m) for the stop pose and the stance. Arrival ranges come from the reach map (runs/l1w_s3_map.json).
v1 = the settings dataset level1_walkup_v1 and run1 used, frozen 2026-11-01 for a fair run1 vs run2 comparison
(82 --randomization configs/randomization_v1.json). textures off: the keys exist only because load() wants every key.
table_style block: the solid table run1 saw (added 2026-11-01; the physics is the same as with legs).
render_look basic: LeRobot's lamp, strong headlight, mirror floor - the look run1 saw (added 2026-11-01, visual only).
objects.table_height_m 0: run1 always had the table top at 0.74 m (added 2026-11-01).
